intent: WindowsでAndroid版と同じ文言、4工程、情報順、PAD編集導線を、画面サイズに応じた拡大縮小だけで使用できる

reference.authority: Android capture proves visual/copy target; Windows capture proves only the packaged baseline appearance, not backend or Human acceptance
reference.notes: Primary and implementation are both loaded CHOP states with two assigned PADs, selected A02, slice markers and the same shared MaterialTheme. Empty CAPTURE remains a separate packaged-state receipt.

copy_policy.observed_copy: Pixels are transcribed without silent correction; punctuation, capitalization, numerals, and line roles are preserved.
copy_policy.authoritative_copy: shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/choplab/sampler/ui/OtohiroiDeck.kt and GuidedWorkflow.kt own current product copy.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not retype a Windows-only copy set
Do not infer backend success from a visible enabled button
Do not replace Japanese labels with desktop-specific synonyms

coordinate_system.canvas: full 1080x2424 Android capture including platform chrome

screen_state_acceptance.evidence_limit: Appearance and visible Android state only; not current Windows backend proof.
Complete same-workflow packaged appearance at one DPI; physical audio, touch, provider state and Human approval remain separate.
Complete packaged empty-state appearance at one DPI; loaded CHOP parity, audio quality, provider state, and Human approval remain separate.

completion_criteria: Every product region maps to shared implementation or an explicit platform adaptation
All observed and authoritative copy is independently reviewable
Windows packaged-runtime captures cover the same CHOP-loaded state at supported DPI settings
No P0 or P1 visual mismatch remains at the minimum supported viewport
Keyboard focus, long strings, loading, error, recording, playing, and save states are exercised
Backend, provider, device, public, and Human evidence gates remain separate from screenshot appearance
